result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and marked crosswalks. However, the environment is compromised by faded pavement markings and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the crossing points.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners block the line of sight between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb on the right side of the main roadway.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, uncontrolled intersection with a marked continental crosswalk and a sidewalk on the left side. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the lack of traffic signals, refuge islands, or speed-calming measures creates a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: A marked crosswalk across multiple lanes without visible traffic signals or stop signs to mandate driver yielding.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The corner design allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing risk to pedestrians at the crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: RRFB Installation
interventions.description: Install Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians in the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with standard pedestrian infrastructure including high-visibility continental crosswalks, signals, and curb ramps. The primary safety concerns are the wide crossing distance across multiple travel lanes and a large vehicle obstructing sightlines at the corner.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to spend a significant amount of time exposed to traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white truck positioned near the crosswalk obscures the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and a dedicated bike lane, but the wide multi-lane roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians. Large vehicles and parked cars along the curb line create significant visual obstructions that may hide pedestrians from oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Large vehicle visual obstruction
hazards.description: A large box truck parked or idling near the intersection on the left side significantly blocks the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic plus a bike lane without a median refuge, increasing exposure to vehicle conflict.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a physical barrier.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
